judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is the 'Geral' pill in the site's horizontal section bar (Últimas, Geral, Publicidade Legal, Educação, Minas...), linking to /geral, whose page is titled 'Geral'. 'Geral' is the standard name of a Brazilian newspaper's general-news section, and in a row of section links its text alone tells the user it opens that section, so 2.4.4 is met by the link text alone; no other context is needed. The live page's server HTML has the identical markup, and the screenshot shows the styled bar as captured, so the capture does not differ. Rampa was right to report nothing.
